routines.source: cft_golden/routines.py: divfull's and sqrtfull's instructions, relocated and specialised at the program's attribute; the math library's fragments, cft_golden/mathlib.py's, built at the program's format and attribute
routines.flags: each runs in a quiet region and raises exactly its operation's flags: revision 8's flag control, QUIET, ENDQUIET and RAISE (docs/SEQUENCER.md R24); the math library's atan, asin, acos and atan2 likewise set the raised word's bit 7 where their in-lane test cannot decide the last bit, and mark the lane as the six do (R23's byte [7], STATUS[6]; docs/LANGUAGE.md, "A marked lane")

cost_model.assumes: revision 7, a single-pass tile (docs/SEQUENCER.md R12-R19); measured on revision 7's quad on the U50, where ten compiled programs ran 2.2% to 5.8% slower than this model (docs/VALIDATION.md, 2026-10-02)
cost_model.routines: QUIET and ENDQUIET a cycle each, RAISE a beat a cycle once its register has landed: believed, from R18's prices for the control codes it built, since no compiled image with a routine has been timed on a card
